distribution.summary: 四川；福建；海南；广西；云南；西藏；台湾
distribution.narrative: 黄复生等 (2015) provides mainland province-level records from 四川、福建、海南、广西、云南、西藏. Beaver & Liu (2010) adds Taiwan occurrence under the source name Dryocoetiops coffeae. Beaver et al. (2019) independently reports Dryocoetiops moestus from Sichuan, Yunnan, and Taiwan; these records support a subset of the already accepted distribution and do not reduce the existing synthesis.

host_note: 黄复生等 (2015) provides explicit host taxa. Beaver & Liu (2010) describes the taxon as a polyphagous twig borer and secondary pest of Coffea spp.; Coffea spp. is retained at genus level without replacing the existing species-level Coffea arabica record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Dryocoetiops moestus (Blandford, 1894).

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Dryocoetiops moestus (Blandford, 1894), VSN_2454, Scolytinae: Dryocoetini. 黄复生等 (2015) and Beaver & Liu (2010) use the source name Dryocoetiops coffeae; current synthesis follows integrated taxonomic backbone while retaining the older name at source layer.
